reference.title: Fieldbook version history and change impact
reference.shortdesc: The releases of Fieldbook 2.x, what each one changed, and what each role notices first after the 2.4 release. Use the impact table to plan who needs a message, a short training, or nothing at all. Fictional sample written for this portfolio.

strow.stentry: Offline work orders, bulk scheduling, signature capture. API v1 removed.
Work-order lists for large accounts, CSV export in the background, API v1 stops accepting new integrations.
API v2 released with cursor pagination and UTC timestamps. API v1 deprecated. Checklists on work orders.
Teams and team-based visibility, the daily digest email, single sign-on with OpenID Connect.
The current mobile app replaces the 1.x app. Parts catalogue on the device.
Sign-in stopped working at the 2.4 release.

section.title: Change impact by role, 2.4
section.p: What each role sees first, and what they need from you. "Nothing" means the change is invisible to them unless they look for it.

strow.stentry: A Waiting to sync state and a conflict prompt. Needs a short explanation.
Work orders that update late in the day. Needs to know why.
A new Schedule selected action. Needs ten minutes with the proposal screen.
A Sign step on completed work orders. Needs to know when to offer it.
The signature field on completed work orders in API v2.
Move every call to v2 before the release.
Signs in at the start of a shift after a day off.
Raise it for shared devices if needed.
Devices on 2.2 or older show Update required.
Update the fleet before the release.
The email has a new subject line.
One message: the app updates, you sign in again, offline mode if your team has it, the conflict prompt.
A week before, and again the day before
One message with a link to the bulk-scheduling guide, and a short session on the proposal screen.
A message per integration that still calls v1, with the migration guide.
As early as possible, and until the Last used column shows no v1 calls
